retrievalProfile.description: A 2000s-era urban romantic aesthetic featuring a centered male portrait against a textured, grungy background with layered, high-contrast gold script and handwritten typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a young man in streetwear sitting in a relaxed pose, set against a multi-textured background of blue, yellow, and dark chalkboard textures. The composition is dominated by large, ornate gold-beveled script lettering in the foreground and casual white handwriting in the mid-ground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and slightly angled to the left
Large gold script overlapping the subject's lower torso
High contrast between dark chalkboard background and bright white/gold text
Lens flares and sparkles integrated into the metallic lettering
coreInvariants: Gold beveled texture on primary display text
Layered typographic hierarchy with at least three distinct styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium shot, seated.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, golden 'F' script in the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face, down to the large gold script, then right to the white handwritten text, and finally to the bottom metadata line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper right quadrant over the dark chalkboard area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black chalkboard textures providing a dark base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for secondary text and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold with yellow highlights for the primary logo-like text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the glowing, saturated gold elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of ornate copperplate script and casual marker handwriting.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extreme flourishes and swashes
Secondary text mimics quick, monolinear handwriting
Tertiary text uses a stylized, small-caps serif with circular ornaments
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'F' with extended descender and top swash
Lowercase 'i' replaced with circular or sun-like glyphs in metadata
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of formal, ornate metallic script with casual, raw handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base for the ornate flourished lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a young man in a brown jacket and striped hoodie, seated against a background featuring blue paint splatters and a dark, grungy chalkboard texture on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, gold-beveled script logo in the lower center with sparkles, and add white handwritten text in the upper right chalkboard area.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text beveled and gold?
Is there a clear contrast between the script and the handwriting?
Does the background have a distressed, multi-textured feel?
Are lens flares present on the metallic lettering?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on gold text
Ensure background textures don't obscure the subject's face
Verify the handwritten text looks natural and not like a standard font
Confirm the presence of the small-caps metadata line at the bottom
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Grungy Chalkboard + Gold Beveled Script + Casual White Handwriting + Lens Flares
